newsitem.title: USA: LCRA sees 430 MW Texas gas plant on line Wed.
newsitem.headline: LCRA sees 430 MW Texas gas plant on line Wed.

text.p: Lower Colorado River Authority (LCRA) said Tuesday the restart of its 430 megawatt (MW) natural gas-fired Ferguson generating plant has been delayed until Wednesday.
"It's going to be tomorrow afternoon before it's producing power," said company spokesman Bill McCann.
The station in Marble Falls, Texas, was shut last Thursday following a superheater tube rupture.
LCRA shut a 600 MW coal-fired unit at its Fayette Power Project in La Grange, Texas, this past weekend for seasonal maintenance. The unit is scheduled to restart by early December.
